attributes: Malaria: Spread by FEMALE ANOPHELES MOSQUITO; fever with CHILLS AND SHIVERING; blood test shows Plasmodium; treated with CINCHONA TREE BARK (Quinine)
Ronald Ross: Discovered mosquito transmission of malaria in 1902; received Nobel Prize in 1902
Anaemia: Deficiency of Haemoglobin/Iron in blood; Normal range: 12 TO 16 g/dL; Remedy: AMLA, JAGGERY (गुड़), GREEN LEAFY VEGETABLES
Vector control: Pouring kerosene on stagnant water puddles to cut off oxygen from mosquito larvae; Gambusia fish in ponds

scientific_experiments_and_processes.procedure: Microscopic analysis of red blood cells
scientific_experiments_and_processes.findings: Identifies Plasmodium parasites in erythrocyte cytoplasm
